summary.root_cause_text: Ops config change moved payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2, which is unreachable. The worker marked orders processed without payment. Worker thread hung in a wait state (heartbeat age over 14s), so the queue backed up. The cause of the hang is not determined.
recommended: Validate that payments-v2 is reachable before retrying the migration.
Find out why the worker hung in the wait state.
Make the worker stop processing orders when the payment provider fails, instead of marking them processed.
